integrity: General analytic proof given; exact finite computations are corroboration, not a proof for unbounded parameters.
limitations: Does not give a formula for arbitrary nonconsecutive weight sets, other norms, polytope volumes or arbitrary affine images; no independent bibliographic priority certification.
scientific_scope: All integers m,n >= 1; standard Euclidean realization of partial permutohedra, rational candidate formula, unique circumball, all contacting rank orbits and sharp full-rank transition.
title: Exact circumball and contact-rank transitions of partial permutohedra
